competitions.description: A solo challenge where you solve real-world programming problems under time pressure. After online selection rounds, the top 10 coders battle it out on the main stage.

timeline.title: Registration Opens
timeline.text: Schools register for the Science Project Showdown (2 students + 1 teacher per team). Individuals sign up for the Coding Competition. Quiz and all participants can register on the spot.

timeline.title: Selection Rounds
timeline.text: Online screening for Science Project and Coding events. Judges evaluate submissions and select the top 10 teams (Science) and top 5 individuals (Coding) to advance to the main event.

timeline.title: Fest Day Grand Event
timeline.text: A full day at Bindubasini Boys' School: live quiz, science project exhibitions at school stalls, coding finale, chess, rubik's cube, special guest sessions, and cultural programs.

timeline.title: Awards & Recognition
timeline.text: To be announced a surprise awaits! We're preparing something truly special for our winners. Stay tuned for the big reveal.

members.name: A. N. M. Bazlur Rahman Sir

faqs.a: Students from class 6-10 can participate. The ICT Quiz is open to all individuals. The Science Project Showdown requires school-based teams (2 students + 1 teacher). The Coding Competition is open to individual participants.
For the Quiz section the fee is 19 BDT, for the Coding Competition the fee is 49 BDT, and the other sections are free.

faqs.q: How do the selection rounds work?
faqs.a: For the Science Project Showdown and Coding Competition, online screening rounds will be conducted. Top 10 teams (Science) and top 5 individuals (Coding) advance to fest day. The ICT Quiz is held live with no prior selection.

faqs.q: What do we bring for the Science Showdown?
faqs.a: Selected teams can bring a powerpoint presentation or any presentation on a pen drive, science project or any mean, with which they can showcase their idea or project.
Selected participants will be notified. Specific guidelines and problem formats will be shared with selected finalists before the fest.

Schools register through the official form for the Science Project Showdown (2 students + 1 teacher). Students can register individually for other events. The registration link is available on the website and our Facebook page. Participants can also register via physical forms.
